mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, the weather is looking beautiful with clear skies and a temperature of 77 degrees out by Reddan Soccer Park under a waning gibbous moon.

The Verona Police Department Records Section manages all official documentation for the city. If you need a traffic crash report, you can access it through crashdocs.org ten days after the incident, while other document requests are processed within ten business days.

Today, you can visit the Remote Area Medical clinic at Verona Area High School. For entertainment, check out live music at Bailey's Run or the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, yoga is scheduled for tomorrow at Insight Wellness.
During the week of July 20 to July 27, officers handled several incidents, including an arrest on July 26 where a driver was cited for a hit and run accident near West Verona Avenue and Epic Lane.
Today is the perfect day to grab some OREO Cookie Cheesecake at Culver's, which is open until 10 PM. You can also catch a Kona Ice at Fireman's Park today from 11 AM to 2 PM.
